category_title: High-intelligence elementary student with inattentive ADHD and executive functioning deficits
scenario_title: Missing instructions during a science experiment
minimal_context: Gail is transitioning from putting away a poster board project to starting a science experiment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please put your poster board away with the other projects, and then we will begin today's science experiment. I've also explained when the extra credit is due.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes an inordinate amount of time to put her poster board with the other projects along the wall closest to her desk)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Gail, please finish putting that away and start working on the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes quite a long time to hand it in and misses part of the instructions regarding the test)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to start the experiment now. Do you know what to do?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The hardest thing in school today was science. I wasn’t sure what steps to do in our experiment and I’m not sure when the extra credit is due, either.
